scope: Public receptor evidence applicable to the selected 2048-neuron MaleCNS graph; not an exhaustive claim that receptor data do not exist
decision: No receptor-specific runtime overrides supported confidently by this audit; retain existing explicitly assumed signs

local_dataset.receptor_type_interpretation: Available non-null values in the full annotation table are putative_IR52b, putative_ppk23 and putative_ppk25: sensory receptor annotations, not postsynaptic neurotransmitter-receptor expression

relevant_primary_evidence.study: Dallmann et al. (2025), Selective presynaptic inhibition of leg proprioception in behaving Drosophila
relevant_primary_evidence.finding: FeCO hook neurons express Rdl (GABA-A receptor); 9A inputs support presynaptic inhibition of movement feedback
relevant_primary_evidence.mechanistic_limit: Axonal shunting and reduced transmitter release cannot be represented as a validated negative somatic current merely by assigning a transmitter sign
relevant_primary_evidence.mapping_status: Hook flexion/extension cell identities have not been validated against the selected MaleCNS bodies

crosswalk_conflict.implication: The local mancBodyid column also associates this numeric identifier with an unrelated type; a numeric-ID-only join is insufficient. Check type, side, dataset version and morphology before applying any mapping

other_primary_resources.use: Adult VNC transcriptomic receptor expression by cluster
other_primary_resources.limit: Requires validated transcriptomic-cluster to connectomic-cell-type matching
Does not establish receptor effects for the selected VNC population

other_primary_resources.use: Literature-backed presynaptic transmitter evidence and cell-type crossmatching
other_primary_resources.limit: Transmitter identity does not establish postsynaptic receptor-specific effects
